Full proofs, independent AI audits, exact bounded coverage, vacuous forcing-test limits and prior source credit retained. General odd-hole-free division and clique-cutset exclusion remain unresolved; no novelty or full-solution claim. The two lanes and core addendum constitute one third pass; lifetime total unknown; no fourth- or fifth-pass material included. The preceding second-pass findings are preserved as history. [Third-pass boundary/core edition](attempts/3251_boundary_core_20261012/README.md). Fourth pass: audited exact singleton-propagation extension criterion for P containing the original high-incidence core X; matching signed P-trees characterize every failure. The explicitly corrected representation consists of entire unmarked dual-tree components, with at most 2 times the number of original maximum cliques signed clauses and 2L literal occurrences, linear in the supplied incidence list. Necessary odd-hole-free indivisibility bounds: size(X)≥3k−4 for k≥4, strengthened to 3k−3 when the core clique number is k−1; at k=4, size(X)≥8 and the core contains K4 without minimality. A connected chordal 4k+1 family has exact core K_k disjoint K_(k−1) and exactly two nonextendible core divisions, while every whole graph is divisible. This refutes arbitrary-core-extension only. Full target and unrestricted clique-cutset closure remain unresolved; no novelty or human-review claim. [Fourth-pass edition](attempts/3251_exact_core_20261012/README.md). 2026-10-12 fifth and final pass complete; ≥5 confirmed, lifetime total unknown: [final frontier](attempts/3251_final_frontier_20261012/README.md) preserves the corrected linear-size signed projection (at most 2m clauses, 2L literals; O(n+L) from supplied original incidences), arbitrary bounded-degree-tree chordal realizations and repeated-leaf examples. All constructed graphs are divisible; their bad prescriptions are not core divisions. The k=4 repeated-leaf core has nine vertices and leaves the eight-core frontier unresolved. Final structural/core bounds and imported historical k=4 order bound 19 are recorded; 22/24 clique/edge-cutset bounds require induced-minimal indivisibility. Complete proofs, audits, corrections and exact historical scopes are preserved in the recovered edition; the old full executable chain is unavailable and historical large audits were not rerun. Unrestricted target remains unsolved; no novelty, latest-best or full-solution claim; no sixth pass. |  |
